lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is generally uniform, with slight narrowing toward the posterior and wider intervals in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th line from the posterior near the dorsal ridge. A secondary merging of line segments is observed on the 7th line at the mid-lateral torso level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, and 3 extend from the dorsal ridge to the lower belly. Lines 5, 8, and 9 are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso and failing to reach the lower ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 distinct, high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch area, situated between the tail base and the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch align vertically. A distinct, thick white diagonal band is present on the upper-most section of the posterior hind limb.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow an upward and outward vector with a pronounced spiral twist, creating a lyrate silhouette. The angle of departure from the skull is approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the nasal bridge.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the ocular regions, white sub-ocular spots on the maxillary region, and a continuous white dorsal fringe extending from the nape to the tail.
